title: Coolify “plugins” — what’s real, and Authentik SSO settings
summary: Coolify has no plugin marketplace. Extensibility is one-click services, Traefik middleware, and CLI/MCP. Same day: recommended Authentik SSO for Coolify dashboard login with exact callback and Base URL values. Also: Astra Portal clear, Anthropic–Decart walkaway, Mistral mega-round.

sections.heading: Coolify plugins (reality check)
bullets: No official Coolify plugin system or marketplace (community FR exists; theme experiments are separate).
What people call plugins: ~280+ one-click service templates, Traefik middlewares (Authentik forward-auth, CrowdSec), coolify-cli, built-in MCP, community coolify-mcp, Terraform.
High-value next services for this stack: Uptime Kuma, Umami/Plausible, MinIO/Garage, Vaultwarden, n8n, Outline, Grafana/Prometheus.

sections.heading: Authentik SSO for Coolify (what to put where)
bullets: Use Settings → OAuth → Authentik (named card), Coolify ≥ v4.3.0.
Coolify Base URL: https://auth.efortune.tech (origin only — no /application/o/slug/).
Authentik: Confidential OAuth2/OIDC client; scopes openid profile email; bind coolify-admins group; MFA on Authentik flow.
After accounts exist: Coolify Registration Allowed = off; keep break-glass local admin password.
Dashboard SSO ≠ Traefik forward-auth (different Authentik provider type).
